# Catching a fast ball

<!-- STEP id="stiff" -->
A fast cricket ball has to be stopped when it is caught. If the hands are held stiff, the ball stops in a very short time. Its velocity changes very quickly, so the force on the hands is large.

<!-- STEP id="give" -->
A fielder pulls her hands back with the ball as she catches it. The ball now takes a longer time to stop. So its acceleration is smaller, and so is the force needed to stop it. Her hands are less likely to be hurt.
